description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Reborn Mode] to the user

description.name: Chaos Gouge
description.text: Six single attacks (0.90 each), grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies if the user has Chaos Flux level 1, causes Chaos Flux -1 to the user

description.name: Round Edge
description.text: Three single attacks (0.90 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] and Chaos Flux +1 to the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Reborn Mode
description.text: Casts Chaos Reborn when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
